question.text: Two projectiles $\mathrm{A}$ and $\mathrm{B}$ are thrown with the same speed but angles are $40^{\circ}$ and $50^{\circ}$ with the horizontal. Then

options.text: both will fall at the same time

solution.text: $\mathrm{T}=\frac{2 \mathrm{u} \sin \theta}{\mathrm{g}},$ lesser is the value of $\theta$, lesser is $\sin \theta$ and hence lesser will be the time taken. Hence A will fall earlier.
